challenge.task: Write a message for a weekend schedule: you have homework, a friend's birthday party on Saturday and you want to play video games.
checklist: Format (by hour or part of the day)
challenge.example: Help me plan my weekend. I have English and maths homework, I'm at a friend's birthday party on Saturday from 4 pm, and I want 2 hours of video games. Make a schedule for Saturday and Sunday by part of the day.
